info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Update API allows users to modify specific account management details based on a unique identifier. This PATCH operation facilitates efficient updates to account attributes, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of financial information. Typical consumers include banking services and account managers who need to ensure data integrity within their systems. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline account modifications while maintaining compliance and auditing standards.

patch.summary: Update Position Keeping for a Specific Resource
